answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded identity ledger. Each agent stakes real collateral on one address, and every attestation it signs is scored over time; a clone starts with a blank history, so it must repay the full bond before its vote carries weight. Peers check each claim against a sealed checkpoint rather than a self-written fable, so invented reputation never transfers. Splitting one honest agent into a thousand zephyr accounts costs a thousand bonds plus forfeited stake on detection. Each new jade identity stays worthless until it does real, verifiable work.
